description:
Validate vault files against the schemas.

Usage: [--schemas DIR] [--quiet] [PATHS ...]

Args:
  PATHS  files to validate; none = walk the whole vault

Flags:
  --schemas DIR  schemas directory (default: the schemas bundled with the package)
  --quiet        suppress per-violation output; exit code only

Examples:
  []
  ["--quiet"]
  ["threads/Projects/Northwind.md"]

Notes:
  Read-only.
  Violations print as <absolute-path>:<line>: <message>. Files that are not valid UTF-8 are reported here as 'file is not valid UTF-8'; other commands skip them silently.
  Exit 0: clean. Exit 1: violations found. Exit 2: no schemas loaded.
